summary: Implement the frozen provider-neutral import/export capability as a release-gated CSV/JSON Product pipeline with versioned mappings, deterministic preview evidence, fail-closed commit and canonical export encoding.

impacts.evidence: Import uses authenticated tenancy.Scope only; ReleasedObjectRef storage keys must carry the same organization/workspace prefix and Catalog writes receive the same validated scope.
The engine does not copy raw source bytes into reports. Preview/result evidence contains bounded canonical product fields, row/error codes and SHA-256 fingerprints only.
Task 031 adds no public HTTP operation. The internal engine remains unavailable to uploaded content until Task 088b can produce a security-evidenced ReleasedObjectRef.
Committed Products use the existing Catalog repository mutation port and therefore preserve existing versioned Catalog outbox event contracts; no new event type is introduced.
Import mappings are provider-neutral source-field bindings and do not enter Connector SDK v1 or provider implementations.
The Task-031 skeleton adds no persistence table or migration. Mapping persistence and durable import jobs remain later extensions rather than an implicit new source of truth.

Importer input is only a private-field ReleasedObjectRef, not client filenames, URLs or object keys. Exact released size/SHA-256 is verified before preview and again immediately before commit; invalid previews cannot be committed.

The first bounded Product slice is preview-before-commit and fail-closed on any row validation error. Approval thresholds for large or sensitive future import classes remain explicitly outside this skeleton and continue to route through Task 017.

Preview and result reports bind source SHA-256 and mapping fingerprint; each Product mutation uses the existing Catalog event boundary. Durable import-run audit/lineage persistence is not falsely claimed in this repository slice.

Duplicate Product IDs/codes inside a source are rejected. Replaying a prepared import treats an already-existing exact Product as unchanged and divergent conflicts as bounded row failures without overwrite.
Task 031 performs no network egress or webhook delivery. Released bytes are read only through a host-supplied ReleasedReader port.
Import size/row/column/error limits are explicit and deterministic; no production throughput or latency SLO is claimed before real storage and 088b integration qualification.

No schema rollback is required. Disable the import entrypoint to stop new commits; Catalog mutations retain their existing immutable event/audit semantics and are not destructively rolled back by this engine.

Tests cover CSV/JSON mapping, duplicate rejection, non-committable invalid preview, tampered released bytes, idempotent replay, export encoding, stable mapping fingerprints and quarantine fail-closed behavior.
